bl_p50: PREREG50 (October 28, 2026, on firebreather) followed PREREG48 by matching the engine's ingrowth threshold to the QC inventory floor. On the 160 screened qc_c fold B stands, the stems deviation goes from 24.2 points low under the frozen 14.1 run to 1.8 points high under E1, the engine with its threshold at the floor (signed deviation -1.759 points, 95% site cluster interval -8.065 to 3.727), with an explained share of 1.0726 (0.8700 to 1.4083). Rule 3 fires: the PREREG48 deficit is mostly a floor handling artifact, so the 14.3 QC ingrowth track is a benchmark and runner convention, an ingrowth threshold matched to the inventory floor, not an ingrowth coefficient. It carries the labels "previously inspected population" and "threshold support unknown", since no record shows the engine's ingrowth equations fitted at thresholds of 9 to 34 cm, and on the 7 stands with floors of 31 to 34 cm both conventions overpredict new stems severalfold. The open loop S2 convention runs 7.18 points high on fold B, and the ungated fold A replication reads rule 4, with S2 just past the overshoot bound. The survivor excess PREREG48 found is unchanged (ratio 1.0943 under E1) and is now the larger remaining stems error. 14.2 keeps QC_AFAC 0.111 and NB_AFAC 0.579.
bl_143: Three more studies for 14.3 ran on Cardinal the same day, and none changes 14.1 or 14.2. 14.3 PREREG3 tested T forms beyond the PREREG2 family: the fit set selects T4, a release that rises to about r 1.0 and then falls as roughly r^−1.6 (pooled CV 0.09692 against 0.09740 for the refit C2 form, a paired difference of about 1.2 SE), but every stress variant reselects H0, the engine no harm gates were not evaluated, and the confirmation set has 10 heavy stands against a floor of 30, so the verdict is open (rule 5), T4 is not adopted and 14.3 keeps the 14.1 T. 14.3 PREREG4, senescence conditioned on forest type, gives no verdict (rule 1), because harness gate H3 failed: stand counts match the frozen score table on 12 of 19 sets against a registered floor of 15. Its fit found no eligible form, but a post selection diagnostic shows the observed mortality measure is not valid, since mefia_l_c TREE ids do not reliably pair the same tree across visits, so the question is still open. Its registered diagnostic arm D1, 14.1 with the floor hazard removed in non spruce-fir stands, cuts the share of fold B stands declining by year 200 from 0.741 to 0.840 under 14.1 to 0 to 0.333 in the five non spruce-fir types, but the stands then overshoot, at 2.06 to 2.91 times the FIA biomass curves at year 100. The Howland decline diagnostic explains the Howland projections above. Its harness reproduced the frozen runs (210 of 210 files md5 identical), but the hindcast is not scoreable, because Howland's t2 tree list is a copy of t1 and its DBH columns from 2010 to 2026 are a reconstruction. At ESI 15 mortality carries 1.477 (1.344 to 1.660) of the 14.1 minus 13.1h net difference by year 50; turning the linked mortality lever off removes 2.545 (1.690 to 5.635) of the 14.1 decline but brings back the first cycle shock (-15.84% at year 5); and the L2 floor hazard supplies most of the 14.1 mortality at Howland. The repeat ALS source located on Cardinal is ORNL DAAC 2490 version 2 (doi:10.3334/ORNLDAAC/2490), 1.148 Mg C ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ from 2012 to 2025 from map means (trend 0.903), not confirmed as the source of the README statement of October 23. Each of the four RESULTs of October 28 was revised once after an independent read only check recomputed every headline value, and the earlier text is kept beside each (`scripts/v14.2dev/2026-10-28/prereg50/`, `docs/v14.3/run_v143p3/`, `docs/v14.3/run_v143p4/`, `docs/v14.3/run_howland_decline/`).
cand_qc: PREREG50 places the QC stems deficit in floor handling (rule 3): the ingrowth threshold matched to the inventory floor is a benchmark and runner convention for 14.3, not an engine candidate.
open_qc: PREREG50 (October 28, 2026) shows that matching the ingrowth threshold to the floor removes the deficit on fold B (24.2 points low to 1.8 points high), so what remains is the threshold support of the engine's ingrowth equations at floors of 9 to 34 cm, where at 31 to 34 cm both conventions overpredict new stems severalfold, and the survivor excess of about 9%.
open_thin: 14.3 pre-registration 3 (October 28, 2026) selected T4 on the fit set but is open under rule 5 (every stress variant reselects H0; 10 heavy confirmation stands against a floor of 30), so 14.3 keeps the 14.1 T.
open_sen: 14.3 pre-registration 4 (October 28, 2026) gave no verdict (harness gate H3 failed), and its observed mortality measure proved invalid on mefia_l_c; its diagnostic arm D1 shows that the floor hazard carries the hardwood decline, but removing it overshoots the FIA biomass curves. The Howland decline diagnostic finds the same mechanism on 93 plots: mortality carries the 14.1 decline, and the L2 floor hazard supplies most of it. A repeat needs mortality from the FIA tree linkage and, at Howland, a field remeasurement.
